description: Free, never charges, works without a key. Without steps: the credits one operation would cost (operation caption, transcribe, burn, preview, translate, shorts, trim, dub or preview {mode:'sample'}) from durationSeconds, or from mediaUrl/fileId with a key. With steps: prices a whole pipeline of 1-10 steps, checks every limit before you pay (limitViolations with a fix for each), suggests free alternatives and, with a key, says whether the balance covers it. 1 credit = 1 cent. Call it before any paid tool when the cost matters.

durationSeconds.description: Media length in seconds. Enough on its own: no key or media needed.

fileId.description: Uploaded file id; its duration is read when durationSeconds is not given (needs a key).

hasTranscript.description: true when you already have a transcript (subtitles or transcriptionJobId): transcription is not priced.

hasTranslation.description: true when you already have the translated captions: translation is not priced.

mediaUrl.description: Public media link; its duration is probed when durationSeconds is not given (needs a key).

source.description: What you know about the input: {durationSeconds, bytes, via: url|upload, transcriptCues, mediaUrl}. Used to price and check limits.

platform.description: burn, preview, shorts: platform id or alias. Validated, same price.

targetLanguage.description: dub only. Checked against the supported voices.

translateTo.description: caption only: include translation in the price.

name: estimate

hasMore.description: true when more items are available (paginated lists).

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page (paginated lists).

result.description: The value, when the tool returns something other than an object.
